translation.name: Seoul Forest to Seongsu Design Walk
translation.summary: A relaxed walk from Seoul Forest into Seongsu's tea, immersive retail, warehouse architecture and creative streets.
translation.description: This route connects the calmer Seoul Forest side of the neighborhood with Seongsu's design-heavy retail and industrial reuse. It works well for travelers who prefer walking and browsing over a tightly scheduled checklist. The route moves from green space to Korean tea, immersive flagship retail, a converted warehouse landmark and finally Yeonmujang-gil.

stops.note: Begin with an easy park walk before moving into the busier commercial streets.
A slower Korean tea stop; confirm reservation rules if you want a course experience.
Explore the flagship as both retail and spatial design.
Notice how Seongsu reuses former industrial buildings as creative spaces.
Finish by browsing side streets and any current pop-ups around Yeonmujang-gil.
